reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: In our latest update, we've refined how units move and attack in Provincia. No more teleporting soldiers or awkward formations! Check out the details on how we've improved drag facing, attack turns, and marching mechanics. Learn more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Update: Ranks That Turn and March
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to Provincia that enhances unit movement and attacking mechanics.
